note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-24): 11 pictures from 22 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper half to 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. God is not pictured; the ark, the flood and the animals are shown as the text's own images, and Noah and his family only through ordinary people of today. Nothing violent is shown: the violence and the deaths are shown by their aftermath and by silence. Picture ideas already used in Genesis 5 (walking into bright cloud, a father with three sons) were avoided.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: As people multiplied, the sons of God saw that the daughters of humankind were good to look at and took whichever they chose: the same seeing and taking as at the tree.
ideas: At an evening party in a grand hall, a powerful man in a fine suit stands at the top of the staircase and points down at one young woman in the crowd, as if choosing her
Three powerful men in expensive suits lean on a balcony rail above a street festival, looking down and pointing out young women in the crowd
A man's hand reaches out of a crowd to take a ripe red apple from a market stall
A crowded city street seen from above, people everywhere
Rich young men in a sports car cruise slowly past young women on a sidewalk, looking them over
A wealthy man slips a ring onto a young woman's finger while she looks away unsure
A man's hand points through a shop window full of beautiful things: that one
A busy hospital nursery full of newborn baby girls in their cots
A man fills his pockets with fruit in an orchard that is not his
A long line of young women waiting while a seated man looks them over

sections.meaning: God's spirit will not stay in people forever, because they are flesh: their days are given a limit, a hundred and twenty years.
ideas: An old man's weathered hands hold an hourglass by a window, the sand running
A tall wooden hourglass on a bare table, its top glass two thirds empty, sand falling in a fine stream
A candle burned more than halfway down in a dark room
An old man's breath fogging a cold window and fading
Autumn leaves falling from a great tree
A long road running to a horizon where it ends
An old man looks in a mirror with a photo of his young self tucked in the frame
Wildflowers that bloom and wither in one field
The shadow moving across a sundial in a garden
An old man's last breath of steam rising in cold air

sections.meaning: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days: the mighty men of old, men whose names everyone knew.
ideas: A row of enormous bronze statues of strongmen of old along a city avenue, tiny people walking at their feet and looking up
A towering giant of a man walks through a market crowd, head and shoulders above everyone, people turning to stare up at him
A strongman lifts a huge stone over his head before a cheering crowd
A champion carried on the shoulders of a crowd
The huge shadow of a man thrown across a city wall
A hall of fame lined with giant portraits
A giant's footprint in the mud beside an ordinary one
A gigantic stone face carved into a mountainside
An athlete on a high podium in a blaze of camera flashes
A very tall man ducking through a doorway while everyone looks up

sections.meaning: Yahweh saw that every thought people formed was only evil all day long, and he regretted that he had made them, pained to his heart.
ideas: In a quiet studio a painter seen from behind sits slumped before his painting of a whole world, now smeared and ruined, his head in his hand
Seen from behind, a father stands at an upstairs window with one hand pressed to his chest, looking down at his grown sons shouting at each other in the yard
Seen from behind, a father sits alone at a kitchen table at night, head bowed in his hands, a family photo face down
A potter's hands lift a cracked, warped clay pot from the wheel
A craftsman stares at the beautiful ship model he built, now smashed
A gardener kneels in a garden choked with weeds and thorns, head bowed
An architect looks at his building, now covered in grime and broken windows
A tear falling on a child's drawing of a happy family
A man stands in the vineyard he planted, all its grapes rotten
A father's hands hold a broken family photo frame

sections.meaning: Yahweh says he will wipe off the ground the people he created, and with them the animals, the creeping things and the birds.
ideas: A wave sweeps up a beach over drawings in the sand of people, animals and birds, half of them already washed away
Pouring rain washes a sidewalk chalk drawing of people, animals and birds into a blur of colour running down the pavement
A wet cloth in a hand wipes a chalk drawing of people and animals off a slate
An eraser rubbing out a pencil drawing of people
A sponge wiping a whiteboard clean
The tide washing away sand castles with little figures on them
A painting of a crowd being scraped off a canvas
Footprints of people and animals in the sand being smoothed by the sea
A great wave about to break over a beach
A rag wiping a dusty window clean

sections.meaning: But Noah found favor with Yahweh: one righteous man, blameless among the people of his time, who walked with God.
ideas: In a field of withered, dead sunflowers under a grey sky, one sunflower stands upright, green and golden, lit by a shaft of sunlight
In a blackened burned forest, one tree stands green and alive in a beam of light
One lit window in a dark apartment block at night
A spotlight on one face in a dark crowd
One white sheep in a flock of dirty ones
A single lamp burning in a dark street
One sound red apple in a crate of rotten ones
A gardener's hands cupping one living seedling in a dead flower bed
One wildflower growing in a cracked empty parking lot
A single boat afloat in a harbour of sunken wrecks

sections.meaning: The earth was ruined and filled with violence, because all flesh had ruined its way, and God says the end of all flesh has come.
ideas: A town square the morning after a riot, empty of people: smashed shop windows, overturned benches, a burned-out car, smoke drifting
Seen from a hill, a whole valley of towns lying under black smoke from many fires, fields scorched
A river choked with trash, dead trees along its banks
A garden trampled flat, its fences smashed
A shattered front door and broken glass on a doorstep
A dark storm hanging over a ruined city
An apple rotten right through on a table
A rusted, broken, abandoned playground
A city of broken windows at dusk
A cracked and polluted lake with dead fish

sections.meaning: God tells Noah to build a great ark of wood, sealed with pitch inside and out, with rooms, three decks, an opening for light and a door in its side.
ideas: On dry grassland far from any sea, the huge timber frame of an enormous wooden vessel rises, three decks of ribs, with scaffolding, ladders and buckets of black pitch
The huge wooden ark nearly finished on dry grassland far from water, its hull half coated in shining black pitch, scaffolding along its side, the big door opening framed in its side
Close view of a brush spreading shining black pitch along the seams of thick new planks
Timber stacked high in a forest clearing

A carpenter's hands measuring a long beam

sections.meaning: God will bring the flood on the earth and everything will breathe its last, but he will make his covenant with Noah, and Noah and his family will go into the ark.

sections.meaning: Two of every kind of living thing, male and female, are to come to Noah to be kept alive.
ideas: In a green meadow pairs of animals stand side by side, male and female: lion and lioness, stag and doe, ram and ewe, peacock and peahen, two zebras, two elephants
From every side, pairs of animals come out of the forest across a wide grassland, all heading the same way, pairs of birds flying above
Pairs of animals walking up a ramp (kept for chapter 7)

sections.meaning: Noah is to gather every kind of food for himself and for the animals, and Noah did everything just as God commanded him.
ideas: Inside a great wooden hold by lamplight, sacks of grain, baskets of fruit and vegetables, jars and bales of hay stacked high
A loaded farm wagon of hay bales, grain sacks and baskets of apples stands at the foot of the ark's ramp
A barn loft full of hay
A pantry stocked shelf by shelf
Hands loading sacks of grain
A storehouse full to the roof

Bowls of fruit, nuts and grain on a table

scenes.principle: The sons of God saw that the daughters of humankind were beautiful, and they took wives for themselves, whichever they chose.
scenes.shows: Three powerful men in expensive suits lean on a balcony rail above a street festival, pointing out young women in the crowd below.
scenes.prompt: Three powerful men in expensive suits lean on a stone balcony rail above a crowded street festival on a bright afternoon, looking down and pointing out young women in the crowd below as if choosing among them. The men on the balcony are high in the frame; the crowd fills the street beneath them. No church or steeple. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: My spirit will not remain in humankind forever, because they too are flesh, and their days will be a hundred and twenty years.
scenes.shows: An old man's weathered hands hold an hourglass by a window, the sand running.
scenes.prompt: By a window in soft grey morning light, an old man's weathered, wrinkled hands hold up a wooden hourglass at chest height. The sand is running in a fine stream, the top glass already more than half empty. Only his hands, his forearms and the plain sleeve of his sweater are seen; the hourglass is high in the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days. These were the mighty men who were of old, the men of renown.
scenes.shows: Enormous bronze statues of strongmen of old line a city avenue, tiny people walking at their feet.
scenes.prompt: Along a wide city avenue stands a row of enormous bronze statues of mighty men of old, each many times taller than a house, broad-shouldered and proud, in plain short tunics, arms folded or hands on hips. Ordinary people of today walk at their feet, tiny beside them, looking up. Clear blue sky. The statues' heads and shoulders tower in the upper part of the frame. No church or steeple. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Yahweh saw that the evil of humankind was great on the earth, and Yahweh regretted that he had made humankind on the earth, and he was pained to his heart.
scenes.shows: In a quiet studio a painter, seen from behind, sits slumped before his painting of a whole world, now smeared and ruined, his head in his hand.
scenes.prompt: In a quiet painter's studio in dim grey light, a large painting of a whole beautiful world, sea, hills, animals and people, stands on an easel, but it has been smeared, slashed with dark streaks and spoiled. A painter seen from behind sits slumped on a stool before it, his head resting in one hand, his brush hanging from the other. The painting fills the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: I will wipe humankind, whom I created, off the face of the ground, from humankind to beasts, to creeping things, and to the birds of the sky.
scenes.shows: A wave sweeps up a beach over drawings in the sand of people, animals and birds, half of them already washed away.
scenes.prompt: A long smooth beach of wet sand is covered with large drawings traced in the sand: people, horses, cattle, snakes and birds. A wide sheet of sea water from a breaking wave is sweeping up the beach over them; the drawings on one side are already washed away and smooth, the rest are about to go. Seen from a low angle, the drawings and the sweeping water fill the upper part of the frame. Overcast silver light. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: But Noah found favor in the eyes of Yahweh. Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generations.
scenes.shows: In a field of withered, dead sunflowers under a grey sky, one sunflower stands upright, green and golden, in a shaft of sunlight.
scenes.prompt: A wide field of withered, dead sunflowers, brown and drooping, under a heavy grey sky. In the middle of the field one sunflower stands tall and upright, its leaves green and its face bright golden, lit by a single shaft of sunlight breaking through the clouds. The living sunflower is high in the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And the earth was ruined before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
scenes.shows: From a hill, a whole valley of towns lies under black smoke from many fires, the fields scorched.
scenes.prompt: Seen from a hilltop, a whole wide valley of towns and villages lies under columns of black smoke rising from many fires, its fields scorched and its roads empty, under a dull brown sky. The smoke columns and towns fill the upper part of the frame. No church or steeple. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood. You are to make the ark with compartments, and cover it inside and outside with pitch.
scenes.shows: The huge wooden ark nearly finished on dry grassland, its hull half coated in shining black pitch, the big door framed in its side.
scenes.prompt: On dry open grassland far from any water stands the ark, nearly finished: an enormous plain wooden vessel shaped like a long rectangular box, three decks high, its hull coated in black pitch, with a low pitched roof, a row of small openings for light just under the roof, and one large door in its side. Half of the hull is already coated in shining black pitch and half is still bare new wood; wooden scaffolding stands along its side and buckets of pitch sit on the ground. Bright midday light. The ark fills the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: I am about to bring the flood of water on the earth. But I will establish my covenant with you, and you will go into the ark, you and your sons and your wife and your sons' wives with you.
scenes.shows: Under a vast black storm sweeping in across the land, the finished ark stands on dry ground, its side door open and warm lamplight glowing inside.
scenes.prompt: On dry open land the finished ark stands alone: an enormous plain wooden vessel shaped like a long rectangular box, three decks high, its hull coated in black pitch, with a low pitched roof, a row of small openings for light just under the roof, and one large door in its side. Its big side door is open at the top of a long wooden ramp, and warm golden lamplight glows from inside. Behind it a vast black storm is sweeping in across the land, rain hanging from the clouds in grey curtains. The ark and the lit door are high in the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Of every living thing, of all flesh, you are to bring two of each into the ark, to keep them alive with you. They are to be male and female.
scenes.shows: In a green meadow pairs of animals stand side by side, male and female: lion and lioness, stag and doe, ram and ewe, peacock and peahen, two zebras, two elephants.
scenes.prompt: In a wide green meadow on a clear bright day, pairs of animals stand side by side, each a male and a female: a lion and a lioness, a stag and a doe, a ram and a ewe, a peacock and a peahen, two zebras, two elephants, and pairs of birds overhead. The animals stand in a loose row across the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Take for yourself some of every food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself, and it will be yours and theirs for food. And Noah did it.
scenes.shows: Inside a great wooden hold by lamplight, sacks of grain, baskets of fruit and vegetables, jars and bales of hay are stacked high.
scenes.prompt: Inside a great wooden hold with heavy beams, lit by warm hanging lamps, food is stacked high along the walls: sacks of grain, baskets of apples, pears and vegetables, rows of clay jars, strings of onions and bales of hay. The stacked food fills the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.
